title: A Note on the Point-Clothoid Distance Algorithm
summary: Computing the closest point on a clothoid is a recurring task in geometric design, road and railway alignment, and path planning. The efficient algorithm of Frego and Bertolazzi addresses this problem, but its candidate-selection analysis assumes at most one local minimum per search interval. We exhibit admissible configurations with two local minima, raising the question of whether the existing strategy accounts for every possible minimum.
